context_for_next_testing_agent: Board substitution fix is fully confirmed. SIMPLE Accept and Force flows both render persistent confirmation pills. acceptSub/forceSub in /app/frontend/src/components/spot/ItemSetupSec.jsx L367-382 correctly set ONLY state flags (boardSubstitution + fallbackAccepted, plus buyMinBoard='Yes' for Force) without overwriting boardGrade/medium. Render guards `isAccepted && hasFb` and `isForced && hasFb` evaluate true because the next engine recompute still sees the spec grade and still returns gradeFallback. Verified with playwright: 11/11 polls over 5000ms show flags+banners stay visible, decision-needed goes away, SPEC row shows ECT 32 preserved, RUNNING shows 200, 0 page errors, 0 console errors. MP-path BOM Builder modal opens with display-style template picker — Save disabled until items added; this is expected UX, not the substitution-fix bug.
rca of the issue: Original bug (iter 25): acceptSub() / forceSub() mutated patch.boardGrade = r.gradeFallback before applying state. Next engine recompute saw boardGrade='200' === stock grade, returned no gradeFallback, so hasFb went false. The render guards `isAccepted && hasFb` (L525) and `isForced && hasFb` (L538) suppressed the confirmation pills, producing the user-perceived 'flash then disappear'. Fix in this iteration: removed the patch.boardGrade/medium writes; setManyFields now only sets boardSubstitution + fallbackAccepted (+ buyMinBoard:'Yes' for Force). Verified: SPEC row keeps ECT 32; RUNNING row correctly shows 200; pills render and stay; banners persist; no console errors; legacy spot_r1_5.jsx L5918-5919 parity restored.
